g.text: Series website: cameo passes and the live state
A viewer buys a cameo pass
the handle appears in a scene:
No site repo attached? The Showrunner puts
state.json in its log for you to commit.
You connect Stripe yourself; Claude never sees or stores a secret key and never charges, refunds or edits anything in Stripe.
state.json holds only what viewers may see: the open vote and live shares, past parts, the case board, the next drop. Never meters, the map or endings.
Every morning, the Showrunner refreshes the site and imports sales
